protocol: LongMemEval_S frozen dev split; HMS local-models stages (candle, CUDA) on Modal L4 via `longmemeval_modal.py --engine hms --models small --cap 8 --tag s-dev-hms`. Fact extraction compared key by key (same model, revision and prompt) with the cached Python/vLLM 0.11.0 outputs using benchmarks/public/compare_fact_caches.py. Held-out ids untouched.

cost.billing_source: modal billing report --start 2026-10-06 --show-resources, app hms-longmemeval (includes the first attempt's image builds)
cost.cause: The CPU driver container was preempted repeatedly (6 'Container terminated due to preemption' events). Each restart cancelled the in-flight L4 fact shards (1,500 items, about 2 h each), which Modal billed but which never returned, so the ledger never recorded them. The driver's own CPU and memory (8 CPU, 64 GiB, about 8 h) were recorded only when a wave completed.
cost.fix: longmemeval_modal.py now reserves each wave's projected GPU cost plus driver time in the ledger before launching it, and probes throughput with a 32-item first wave; a restarted driver inherits the reservation. Simulated preemption: the ledger keeps the reservation and the restart refuses further waves.

status: stopped by hand at 18:00 PDT 2026-10-06 after the bill was found to exceed the cap; 1,500 of 4,506 fact sessions completed, no embedding, re-rank or retrieval stage ran. The s-dev-hms ledger on the volume was set to the billed amount so the tag cannot be resumed.
